title: Buddy Rich
summary: He met Buddy Rich in Kansas City when Rich sat in with Jay, and Rich later arranged a free Ludwig set.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Gus, we talked about drummers, but there's one or two drummers we didn't talk about. We didn't talk about Buddy Rich, for instance.
No.
And as you said, Buddy used to come and sit in in Basie's band.

That's right. He would always come around and sit in with Basie. And -- but the first time I met Buddy was in Kansas City, and I was playing with Jay when we had the seven pieces. And he came -- he was playing with Artie Shaw's band.
Oh, is that right?

And so the manager of the restaurant where we played, see -- it's a club, restaurant -- the Plaza there in Kansas City, came over and said, 'We have a young drummer out here, and see if you can get him to sit in.' So I said, 'Sure, he can sit in,' one of those things. And he came over there and sat in with the band, and he was something else.
Was he? Already right then, huh?
Right then and there. He was terrific.
And you didn't hear that many good white drummers then.
No. I knew then that he outplayed
Krupa.
Yeah.
Right then I knew he could outplay Krupa, the first time I heard him.
Yeah.
And that's when we first met.
And so we were friends.
We were friends, sure.
Yeah.
And he also gave me a set of drums.
He did? How nice.
When I was in Chicago with Basie, with the A small group.
He did?
He came by and said, 'How would you like a new set of drums?' I said, 'Fine.' So he said, 'Well, go to Ludwig and tell him I sent you over there.'
How about that?

I said, 'Really?' He said, 'Yes, just tell him I sent you.' And I went the next day, and he -- Ludwig said, 'Oh, yeah, you're Gus Johnson, we've been looking for you. Pick out what you want,' just like that.
How about that? That was really wonderful, wasn't it?
That was my first set of drums that was
just given to me.
That you picked out what you wanted.
You know, just given to me.
How nice. Isn't that wonderful? Yeah.
Yeah, that was nice, very nice.
